title: Assemble Streamed Tool Calls
hints: Keep one buffer per block index. Every delta carries its index, so route by it, never by which block started last.
A single partial_json fragment is almost never valid JSON on its own. Concatenate, and parse once at content_block_stop.
An empty (or whitespace-only) buffer means the tool takes no arguments: input is {}. A block that never sees its stop event was cut off and must not run.
Everything after message_stop is ignored, and ping events carry nothing.
